integration_playtest: Playtest: StructureMultiplayerTest used actual TLS server and synthetic protocol clients for all four rotations, initially empty dependency caches, conflicts/cancellation, undo, late join and restart. Default three clients; not shaped-network or 32 rendered clients.

index.bits: 21 x, 21 z, 11 y; bounds checked before packing
index.memory_scope: Only long-array payload. Excludes array header, sorting workspace and all model/cell/geometry allocations. Declared count allocates this array before reading cells; malformed maximum count can therefore allocate 16 MB before rejection. No world mutation occurs before a valid Delta is returned.
index.duplicate_policy: Keys sort after all bounded cells decode, before return/application; no hash chains. Cell list order stays unchanged.

probe.method: Separate JVMs, parent first; no concurrent Maven/native run. Three warmups, 20 measured decodes each. Fixture shuffled with deterministic seed371. Position/order/physical geometry checked after each timed decode; byte-identical re-encoding verified. Times include sorting in current decoder. Allocation is current-thread allocated bytes, not retained or peak memory. Single ordered comparison, not randomized system qualification.
